name: Gille
title: Executor
description: The Executor of Aldebaran, the Primary Star of the western sky. Imprisoned in the Planetarium within Dirac's Well, this being was projected across countless timelines.
introduction:
The Executor of Aldebaran, the Primary Star of the western sky. Trapped in the Planetarium in Dirac's Well, she became a <color=#2A80D8>Spoke</color> in the Cycle, projected across countless timelines to oversee the Journey's <color=#2A80D8>Final Trial</color>.

She loathes Alicia for making the Cycle and locking her inside. She also deeply despises the Star Savior. But when Aldebaran vanished, she too lost her power.

She eventually joined the Journey, hoping to regain her power through the <color=#2A80D8>Stellar Archive</color>.

When an ally attacks, increases that ally's DMG dealt to targets in Toughness Break by 2% per stack of self Agitation, up to 5 stacks. It prioritizes the enemy self attacked most recently among targets in Toughness Break and can only trigger once per turn.
